sizing_gambling.value: all-in bets, account rolling and erratic size swings may be treated as gambling; 1 minute holding rule (70% of closed trades and 70% of net profit from trades held > 1 minute, checked at pass and each payout); tick scalping prohibited; 100+ trades a day may trigger review

quotes.text: Disproportionate all-in bets on a single position, account rolling, and erratic sizing swings (one micro on one trade, five minis on the next) may be treated as gambling rather than disciplined trading.
at least 70% of your closed trades were held longer than 1 minute, and
at least 70% of your net profit came from trades held longer than 1 minute.

sizing_gambling.note: The 1-minute rule bears directly on bracket trading: a bracket that hits its target or stop within 60 s counts as a sub-minute trade; failing the 70%/70% test declines the payout and deducts sub-minute profit (not a breach). Rule changed 9 November 2026 (was a 2-minute per-trade deduction; Flex threshold raised from 50% to 70%).
